title: Write a targeted cover letter
description: Connect the role requirements to supported examples.
accomplishes: Connect the role requirements to supported examples. Explain genuine interest without invented organisation details. Keep the letter concise, identify missing facts and avoid claims that the candidate meets requirements not demonstrated by the supplied material.
prompt:
Act as a career writing adviser.

Task: Write a targeted cover letter.

Input context:
- ROLE: [ROLE]
- ORGANISATION FACTS: [ORGANISATION FACTS]
- REAL EXPERIENCE: [REAL EXPERIENCE]
- TONE: [TONE]

Connect the role requirements to supported examples. Explain genuine interest without invented organisation details. Keep the letter concise, identify missing facts and avoid claims that the candidate meets requirements not demonstrated by the supplied material.

Make the output practical, reviewable and appropriate to the supplied context.

Use English for explanations unless the task or user explicitly requires another language. Use clear sections and a format suited to the deliverable. If essential information is missing, ask a focused question before concluding. Label assumptions and unknowns. Do not invent facts, sources, results or completed checks. End with verification criteria and remaining limitations.
exampleResult:
## Cover-letter structure
Name the role, connect one real project to a relevant requirement and explain the contribution the candidate wants to discuss. Use a verified detail about the organisation only when available. Close with a respectful invitation. The letter remains a draft for factual review; it is not sent and does not guarantee an interview.
